election: Seimas vote approving the appointment of the Prime Minister
detail: Under Article 92 of the Constitution the President appoints the Prime Minister with the Seimas's approval. Sinkevičius, then mayor of Jonava, is not a member of the Seimas. The government took office on 14 July 2026 after the Seimas approved its programme by 72 votes to 29, with four abstentions.
